selection: best validation PSNR (valid split of PanCollection)
train_note: training runs in segments of at most 48 h; continue an interrupted run with the same command plus --resume. The recipe is the method's published one, identical for the three arms.
infer: python scripts/infer.py --method PanDiT --arm original --train-set wv3 --split reduced --weights weights/PanBase --out-dir outputs/PanDiT/original/wv3_reduced
python scripts/infer.py --method PanDiT --arm original --train-set wv3 --split full --weights weights/PanBase --out-dir outputs/PanDiT/original/wv3_full
python scripts/infer.py --method PanDiT --arm original --train-set wv3 --eval-set wv2 --split reduced --weights weights/PanBase --out-dir outputs/PanDiT/original/wv2_reduced
python scripts/infer.py --method PanDiT --arm original --train-set wv3 --eval-set wv2 --split full --weights weights/PanBase --out-dir outputs/PanDiT/original/wv2_full
runtime_note: diffusion sampler; with torch.manual_seed(0) before each test image a CUDA run reproduces the table PSNR exactly (re-runs of 2026-11-23/24); CPU sampling draws a different random stream. About 90-110 s per 20-image test set on an RTX 4090, within 6 GB of GPU memory; 1-2.5 h on a 16-core CPU.
inference_seed: torch.manual_seed(0) immediately before each test image
